# GET /api/v1/user/starred/{owner}/{repo}

Check whether the authenticated user is starring a repo

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-154`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Stars disabled by administrator
- **404** — Not starring the repo or repo not found

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.IsStarring | controller | Check if star record exists for user+repo; Return 204 if starring, 404 if not |
